title: AI vendor due diligence: core questions

questions.question: What does the AI system do, and who owns it?
questions.answerTemplate: {system.name} is owned by {system.owner}. Recorded purpose: {system.purpose}

questions.question: Which model does the system use, and who supplies it?
questions.answerTemplate: The system uses the model {system.modelName}, version {system.modelVersion}, supplied by {system.vendorName}.

questions.question: Is there a model card or equivalent model documentation?
questions.answerTemplate: Model documentation on file: {evidence.MODEL_CARD.titles}. Most recent document indexed on {evidence.MODEL_CARD.latestOn}.

questions.question: Which third-party vendors or subprocessors are involved in the AI system?
questions.answerTemplate: Recorded model vendor: {system.vendorName}. Vendor documents on file: {evidence.VENDOR_DOC.titles}. Devernance does not track other subprocessors; list them separately.

questions.question: What data does the system use, and do you hold the rights to use it?
questions.answerTemplate: Recorded data sources: {system.dataSources}. The data governance control was marked passing on {control.DATA_GOVERNANCE.passedOn}. Vendor documents on file (confirm which sets out usage rights): {evidence.VENDOR_DOC.titles}.

questions.question: How do you monitor the quality of the data feeding the system?
questions.answerTemplate: Data contracts on file: {contracts.names}. Current data contract status: {contracts.status}.

questions.question: Has a data protection or impact assessment been carried out for the system?
questions.answerTemplate: Impact assessment on file: {evidence.DPIA.titles}. Most recent document indexed on {evidence.DPIA.latestOn}.

questions.question: How is the system classified under the EU AI Act?
questions.answerTemplate: Risk class recorded by the workspace: {system.riskClass}. Recorded basis: {system.riskBasis}. This is the workspace's own classification, not a legal determination.

questions.question: Which decisions does the system influence, and who is affected?
questions.answerTemplate: Recorded decision impact: {system.decisionImpact}. Affected groups: {system.affectedUsers}.

questions.question: Where is the system deployed?
questions.answerTemplate: Recorded deployment region: {system.deploymentRegion}.

questions.question: Do you operate a risk management process for the system?
questions.answerTemplate: The risk management control was marked passing on {control.RISK_MANAGEMENT.passedOn}. Supporting documents on file: {evidence.CONTROL_MAP.titles}.

questions.question: How do people oversee the system's outputs and decisions?
questions.answerTemplate: The human oversight control was marked passing on {control.HUMAN_OVERSIGHT.passedOn}. Policy on file: {evidence.POLICY.titles}.

questions.question: How are people told that AI is used in decisions that affect them?
questions.answerTemplate: The transparency control was marked passing on {control.TRANSPARENCY.passedOn}.

questions.question: How is the system evaluated before release?
questions.answerTemplate: The latest completed evaluation ran on {eval.latestOn} against the dataset {eval.dataset}, model version {eval.modelVersion}, and returned the gate decision {eval.decision}.

questions.question: How do you check the system's accuracy and robustness?
questions.answerTemplate: The accuracy and robustness control was marked passing on {control.ACCURACY_ROBUSTNESS.passedOn}. Model documentation on file: {evidence.MODEL_CARD.titles}.

questions.question: How are changes reviewed and approved before release?
questions.answerTemplate: Releases go through a staged approval workflow. {approval.workflowCount} workflow(s) are recorded for this system; the most recent stage approval was given on {approval.latestApprovedOn}.

questions.question: Is there an automated release gate, and what is its current state?
questions.answerTemplate: An automated release gate evaluates this system from its recorded evidence. Current decision: {gate.decision}.

questions.question: Do you keep a tamper-evident audit trail for the system?
questions.answerTemplate: {audit.eventCount} event(s) are recorded for this system in a hash-chained audit ledger; the most recent was recorded on {audit.latestOn}.

questions.question: Does the system keep logs and records of its operation?
questions.answerTemplate: The logging and record-keeping control was marked passing on {control.RECORD_KEEPING.passedOn}.

questions.question: How long are records about the system retained?
questions.answerTemplate: Audit records for this system are held until at least {audit.retainUntil}. Retention of other data is not recorded in Devernance; state it separately.

questions.question: How do you detect and respond to incidents involving the AI system?
questions.answerTemplate: The cybersecurity control was marked passing on {control.CYBERSECURITY.passedOn}. Policies on file (confirm which covers incident response): {evidence.POLICY.titles}.

questions.question: What security measures protect the AI system?
questions.answerTemplate: The cybersecurity control was marked passing on {control.CYBERSECURITY.passedOn}.

questions.question: Is technical documentation for the system maintained?
questions.answerTemplate: The technical documentation control was marked passing on {control.TECHNICAL_DOCUMENTATION.passedOn}.

questions.question: How does the system's evidence relate to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework?
questions.answerTemplate: Evidence is mapped to NIST AI RMF 1.0 at category level: {nist.covered} of {nist.total} categories have both a passing control and an indexed document, and {nist.partial} have one of the two. The mapping shows which evidence is relevant; it is not an assessment against the framework.

questions.question: Can you provide verifiable evidence for the answers above?
questions.answerTemplate: A signed evidence pack (format version {pack.version}) can be exported for this system. Its content hash and RS256 signature can be checked independently against the published key set.
